svg.title: The CLP connector as a plugin in a Presto Native cluster
svg.desc: A SQL client sends a query to the Presto coordinator. The CLP coordinator plugin, loaded as a JAR, reads tables and splits from the metadata database of the CLP package, which manages CLP archives as Iceberg manages Parquet files. The coordinator sends each of many Presto Native workers its plan fragment and splits as JSON, in which every CLP handle is binary-serialized by CLP's codec and carried as Base64 in customSerializedValue. On each worker, the CLP plugin, loaded from a shared library, decodes the bytes and calls clp-s, which both compresses logs into CLP archives and scans them, to read archives directly from the data lake. Result pages return through the coordinator.
